lines.text: Fresh out of the vats and already thinking about leaving? Smart. Convoy seat, under the Kestrel price.
Convoy seats, Scour rides, no questions on the manifest. Ask me tomorrow and the price is worse.

barks.text: Rim run, end of the week. Two seats. One if you're big.
Kestrel sells the tickets. I sell the ones Kestrel forgot it sold.
Ring-fall's coming. Rides go up when the sky comes down.
